description: This Java class named ProvisioningValuesLoader loads default values for NFC provisioning. It retrieves configuration data from a file named 'nfcprovisioning.txt' stored on external storage, and supplements missing values with constants and device settings such as locale, timezone, and WiFi SSID. The class extends AsyncTaskLoader to asynchronously load and provide these provisioning parameters to other components.

classes.name: ProvisioningValuesLoader
classes.description: A loader class for asynchronously loading NFC provisioning configuration values from disk and device settings.

methods.name: loadInBackground
methods.description: Loads configuration values from disk, adds admin extras, and system defaults.

methods.name: deliverResult
methods.description: Delivers loaded values to the registered listener.

methods.name: onStartLoading
methods.description: Starts the loading process, delivering cached results if available.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets the loader to its initial state.

methods.name: loadFromDisk
methods.description: Attempts to load the configuration file from external storage.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Parses the configuration file and loads key-value pairs into the provided map.

methods.name: gatherAdminExtras
methods.description: Collects additional admin extras into a bundle for provisioning.

methods.name: loadSystemValues
methods.description: Populates missing values with system and device-specific defaults like locale, timezone, WiFi SSID.

methods.name: trimSsid
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotation marks from the WiFi SSID string.

methods.name: putIfMissing
methods.description: Helper method to insert a key-value pair into the map if the key is not already present.
